[[File:NGrid_Interviews.jpg|thumb|250px|The "face" of N'Grid]]
'''N'Grid Interviews''' is an electronic entertainment device that features a voice-activated [[Computer/Legends|computer]] persona known as N'Grid. The program speaks to users in various languages, and creates a [[Psychologist/Legends|psychological]] profile after a brief question and answer period. N'Grid's face is portrayed on a screen by moving horizontal lines. Several of these devices were located in [[Astroport Interstellar Services]] at a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Paris only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Real N'Grid Interviews devices were found at the Astroport Interstellar Services arcade area, located after the exit of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride at [[Disneyland Paris]] from [[1993]] to [[2005]].<ref name="Lost Treasures">{{WebCite|url=https://www.designingdisney.com/content/lost-treasures-discoveryland|text=Lost Treasures - Discoveryland|work=Designing Disney|archivedate=20220303153751}}</ref> Some online sources refer to the game as the "Orakel" or "Oracle" but that does not appear to be the official name, which was revealed in a 1993 press kit<ref name="SW Universe">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwars-universe.com/dossier-page-115-736-star-tours-l-attraction-phenomene-les-decors.html|text=Star Tours L'Attraction Phenomene|work=StarWars-Universe.com|archivedate=20201128131949}}</ref> and an article from the French video game magazine ''[[Wikipedia:Tilt (French magazine)|Tilt]]''.<ref name="Tilt">{{BookCite|author=Feroyd, Morgan|container=IBM atterrit chez Mickey|title=Tilt|number=no. 117|date=September 1993|language=French|link=https://archive.org/details/Tilt117/mode/2up}}</ref>
